answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the velvet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
